blocks.text: This Ride Share Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{date}}, between:
Platform Operator: {{platform_name}}, a company organized under the laws of {{jurisdiction}}, with its principal office at {{platform_address}} ("Platform")

items: "Ride" means a single transportation service from a pick-up location to a drop-off location.
"Booking" means a Passenger's request for a Ride through the Platform.
"Fare" means the price charged for a Ride, as calculated by the Platform.
"Ride Share Vehicle" means the Vehicle used by Driver to provide Rides.

blocks.text: Platform provides a digital marketplace connecting Passengers with Drivers. Platform's obligations include:

items: Operating and maintaining the Platform for Driver and Passenger use.
Processing payments from Passengers to Drivers.
{{platform_obligations}}
Maintain a valid driver's license with a clean driving record throughout the Agreement term.
Maintain valid personal auto insurance covering the Ride Share Vehicle.
Comply with all traffic laws, regulations, and Platform policies.
Provide safe, professional, and courteous service to Passengers.
Maintain the Ride Share Vehicle in good mechanical condition.
Not transport any illegal items or substances.
Not exceed the maximum passenger capacity of the Vehicle.
Accurately disclose availability and pricing to the Platform.
{{driver_obligations}}
Provide accurate pick-up and drop-off information when booking a Ride.
Be ready at the designated pick-up location at the scheduled time.
Treat the Driver and Vehicle with respect.
Not engage in disruptive, unsafe, or illegal behavior during the Ride.
Not damage or vandalize the Vehicle.
Pay the Fare as calculated by the Platform.
{{passenger_obligations}}
Fares are calculated by the Platform based on distance, time, demand, and other factors.
Driver receives {{driver_payout_percentage}} of the Fare; Platform retains {{platform_commission_percentage}}.
Payment shall be made through the Platform's payment system.
Driver shall not charge additional fees beyond those set by the Platform unless agreed to by Passenger in advance.
Tips, if any, are at Passenger's discretion and are not included in the Fare.
Both Driver and Passenger must comply with all applicable safety regulations.
Driver must not operate the Vehicle while under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
Passenger must wear a seatbelt at all times.
Driver must comply with any background check requirements imposed by the Platform.
Either Party may terminate a Ride immediately if they feel unsafe.
Driver is responsible for any damage caused by Driver's negligence during the Ride.
Passenger is responsible for any damage caused by Passenger's actions.
Platform is not liable for any accident, injury, or damage arising from a Ride, except as required by law.
Each Party acknowledges the risks inherent in ground transportation and assumes those risks.

blocks.text: Any complaints regarding Rides shall be submitted through the Platform. The Platform may suspend or terminate a Driver's access for policy violations. Persistent complaints may result in termination of this Agreement.

items: Either Party may terminate this Agreement with {{termination_notice}} days written notice.
Platform may terminate immediately for breach of terms, safety violations, or illegal activity.
Driver may decline Ride requests at any time, subject to Platform policies.

blocks.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of {{governing_state}}.
